pillars.title: Therapeutic Approach
pillars.body: At Recovery Ranch, patients can gain a better understanding of their addiction and experiences that led to the onset of the disorder through evidence-based therapies such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and more. Our goal is to provide patients with the tools they need to develop healthy coping mechanisms and build resilience against possible relapse.

pillars.title: Medical Supervision
pillars.body: Our medical team offers 24/7 support to patients within our facility. Medical supervision starts with medically-assisted detoxification and continues throughout the treatment process. They are dedicated to providing personalized treatment that’s tailored to each patient’s specific needs.

pillars.title: Integration with Nature
pillars.body: We surround our patients with nature’s beauty, which offers them an environment that can aid in their healing journey. With endless acres of Crown land and trails, patients can enjoy outdoor activities like hikes through forests of spruce and pine, kayaking, and hiking through hills of grasslands.

overview: Recovery Ranch is a private, secluded addiction treatment centre that provides hope and healing to individuals struggling with addiction and concurrent mental health disorders. The compassionate team at Recovery Ranch is committed to helping patients through the darkest periods of their lives. With medically supervised detox, customized treatment plans and facilitated aftercare programs, Recovery Ranch delivers ongoing support from an expert team of staff including physicians, psychiatrists and a 24/7 nursing team.

At Recovery Ranch, patients can connect with a unique community of peers and expert support counsellors, many of whom have gone through similar journeys. This allows patients to gain a deeper understanding of their addiction and experiences while discovering more about themselves. The environment at Recovery Ranch is the perfect setting for holistic healing as patients can enjoy the natural beauty that surrounds them while indulging in the comfort of the log lodge and cabins. The team at Recovery Ranch is dedicated to providing personalized care that is tailored to each individual’s needs to help them carve a new path forward towards wholeness, health, and hope.

afterOverview: EHN Edgewood Rockies is the current name of the centre our readers may know as Recovery Ranch, and before that as Top of the World Ranch. It is now one of the EHN Canada treatment centres. The property covers about 600 acres on Ktunaxa Nation lands, roughly 3,000 feet above sea level, and looks across the valley to the Kimberley Alpine Resort. People stay in the main log lodge, which has the dining areas, decks and a great room, or in one of seven cabins that each house three people in shared or single bedrooms.

Programs are abstinence-based, with medication assistance if needed. Alongside the core inpatient program there is a hybrid option for people who cannot be away long: two weeks in residence, with medical detox available, followed by eight weeks of online treatment from home. EHN also runs virtual family education workshops for relatives.

location.intro: EHN Edgewood Rockies is on Holmes Road outside Fort Steele, about 20 minutes northeast of Cranbrook in the East Kootenays, with Canadian Rockies International Airport a short drive away. From Vancouver it is about 10 hours by car on Highway 3, or roughly an hour and a half by air to Cranbrook. Kelowna in the Okanagan is about six hours west and Calgary about four hours east, and Kimberley, Fernie and Invermere are all within an hour and a half.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and the EHN Canada website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does EHN Edgewood Rockies cost?
faqs.a: EHN Edgewood Rockies does not publish its prices. Admissions gives you a quote after a free assessment confirms the program is a good fit. It is a private centre, and EHN offers financing through Medicard, including with a co-signer, for people who need to spread the cost.

faqs.q: How long is the program at EHN Edgewood Rockies?
faqs.a: The length of the inpatient program varies with each person's needs, and EHN sets it after the assessment. The hybrid program is shorter on site: two weeks in residence followed by eight weeks of online treatment from home.

faqs.q: Does EHN Edgewood Rockies offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. EHN says it offers medically supervised detox at Edgewood Rockies, and detox is an option at the start of the hybrid program too. You do not need a doctor's referral, so you or a family member can call admissions directly.

faqs.q: Where is EHN Edgewood Rockies and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 8350 Holmes Road in Fort Steele, about 20 minutes from Cranbrook in the East Kootenays. From Vancouver it is roughly a 10-hour drive on Highway 3, or a flight of about an hour and a half to Cranbrook. Calgary is about four hours away by car.

Often it can help. EHN says that in many situations insurance can cover part of the cost, so check your plan's benefits with admissions before you arrive. At discharge you get receipts and a letter confirming attendance and cost, which EHN notes can be useful at tax time.
Graduates of the inpatient program join a weekly aftercare group for one year to keep working on relapse prevention with peers. You also get lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association.

faqs.q: What can I expect during treatment at Recovery Ranch?
faqs.a: You can expect an evidence-based treatment plan tailored specifically to your needs. The plan may include holistic therapies, individual counseling, family therapy, and support groups among others.

faqs.q: Who will be responsible for my healthcare during my stay at Recovery Ranch?
faqs.a: At Recovery Ranch, your healthcare will be overseen by our medical team, consisting of physicians, psychiatrists, and a 24/7 nursing team.

faqs.q: Will my family be able to visit me while I am in treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, Recovery Ranch encourages visits from family and friends. Visiting hours are established, and your therapist can provide you with more information.

faqs.q: How long is the treatment process at Recovery Ranch?
faqs.a: The length of stay depends on the severity of the addiction and individual patient needs. After the initial assessment, we work with you to create a customized treatment plan.

faqs.q: What is the cost of treatment at Recovery Ranch?
faqs.a: The cost of treatment differs depending on the level of care and the services you receive. Our admissions team will provide you with more information.

faqs.q: Can I continue working during my time at Recovery Ranch?
faqs.a: Patients are encouraged to take time off work to focus on treatment. However, we understand that individual patients’ situations are different; our team will work with you to ensure you receive the support you need.

faqs.q: What are the credentials of the Recovery Ranch medical team?
faqs.a: Our medical team comprises licensed physicians, psychiatrists, and nurses specialized in addiction medicine and mental health.

faqs.q: What licenses and accreditations does Recovery Ranch hold?
faqs.a: Recovery Ranch holds an Accreditation Canada accreditation.
